title: Port PLY mesh import (ASCII and binary variants)
scope: Every PLY header/property/endianness/face-list variant the original parser accepts, plus its refusals and size limits, producing the same owned mesh buffers as STL.
acceptance: Generated and adversarial PLY corpus (each header variant, truncated, oversized counts, non-finite values) compares original against Rust on vertices, indices, normals if present, errors and progress.
Malformed or hostile input is bounded and refused with the original's outcome; no panic.
open_items: Both source parser bodies and full dispatcher implemented in io.ply.ascii/io.ply.binary, with independent native evidence; this umbrella remains planned for broader native/browser import acceptance.
Real browser-Wasm parsing, public scan/session integration and P03 corpus acceptance remain open.
